messages:
Megan (Finance): Heads up — client ACME used their promo credits last quarter and is now seeing a 0 balance on their reserved committed pool. They say credits should have been applied to their Dedicated invoice not to hosted usage. Can we find where the credits landed?
Ishaan (CloudOps): Which invoice/commit? share the invoice id and the commitment period.
Megan (Finance): INV-2026-004 and commit: DED-ACME-Q3-2026 (monthly reserved for Sep). Promo code PROMO-ACME-5K applied on 2026-08-10 per the account.
BillingBot: Payment applied: 2026-08-10, credit memo CM-78921 for $5,000 created and assigned to account ACME-corp. Current allocation: 100% to "hosted" bucket.
Sophie (AcctExec): ACME insists credits were sold as a contract addendum to cover Dedicated in Sep. Sales doc attached in PM but not in billing metadata. :grimacing:
Ray (CSE): If credits are in hosted bucket they won't reduce the Dedicated invoice automatically. We can do a manual ledger reallocation but need approvals.
Megan (Finance): Is there an audit trail of ledger reallocations? We need to show compliance and correct the Sep invoice before month-end closing.
Samir (InfraEng): Is there any automated rule that maps promo credits to hosted first? Might be default behavior. I can check billing job `allocate_credits.py` but need a repro case.
Liz (ProvOps): Also note: Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 had a partial outage the week of Aug 22; usage moved to hosted fallback which could explain consumed hosted credit usage.
Ishaan (CloudOps): Good catch — routing fallback would consume hosted tokens. Check the fallback logs: `fallback-router.log` for ACME during Aug22-26. If requests spilled, credits applied to hosted usage are expected.
Megan (Finance): Ok — steps: 1) confirm whether credits were consumed by hosted fallback; 2) if so, propose a manual credit transfer to reallocate CM-78921 to Dedicated invoice INV-2026-004; 3) record GL adjustments.
Sophie (AcctExec): I'll get the signed addendum from legal that says credits apply to Dedicated. That gives finance the authorization.
BillingBot: Reallocation requires: billing@redwood approval + accounting journal entry. Command: `realloc-credit CM-78921 --target INV-2026-004 --reason "contract addendum"` (dry-run available).
Megan (Finance): Who can approve? CFO or billing lead?
Ray (CSE): Billing lead (Marta) is the standard aprover for reassigning promo/contract credits. I'll ping Marta. @Marta can you review and approve manual reallocation for ACME? :eyes:
Megan (Finance): Also we need to check expiration windows — promo credit created 2026-08-10 with expiry 2026-09-30 per the promo terms PDF. If we reallocate after expiry, does system allow it?
Samir (InfraEng): System enforces expiry at redemption time only. The credit was already redeemed by hosted usage so technically not expired. Manual reallocation should be allowed but will require a journal reversal + reapply. We need to confirm with accounting.
Ishaan (CloudOps): If we reallocate back to Dedicated, usage that was billed to hosted will need to be retroactively adjusted. That may change cost distribution across pooled GPUs. Impact on cluster cost reporting. Ops will want a note.
Liz (ProvOps): We'll prepare a short ops note with the affected nodes/pools and dates (eu-west-1, Aug22-26). Might impact reserved util % for that month.
Megan (Finance): Action items: Sophie get addendum; Marta to approve reallocation; Samir prepare ledger/journal steps; Liz & Ishaan confirm fallback logs and quantify hosted consumption; I'll prepare the accounting ticket.
Sophie (AcctExec): Got it, pulling the addendum now, will post within the hour.
Marta (Finance Lead): (joins) Approved pending evidence that credits were intended for Dedicated. Please attach addendum + routing logs.
Megan (Finance): Thanks Marta. If all evidence lines up, proceed with `realloc-credit --execute` and Samir will post the journal entry. Keep me posted so I can close Sep books. :thumbsup:
